title: Need a team knowledge base more than an all-in-one workspace?
intro: Outline is a fast, focused alternative to Notion for team knowledge bases and documentation – on-premises or in the cloud.

features.title: Built for documentation.
features.description: Write with markdown shortcuts, slash commands, and media embeds. Outline focuses on documents and their structure rather than databases and custom views.

features.title: Access control & permissions.
features.description: Manage access with read & write permissions, user groups, guest users, public sharing, and more…

features.title: Structured & instantly searchable.
features.description: Nest documents in a hierarchy, automatically build a network of backlinks and search across everything in ms.

features.title: AI answers & built-in MCP.
features.description: Get instant answers from your knowledge base, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants to search, read, and edit docs with the built-in MCP server.

features.title: Cloud hosted or on-premises.
features.description: Outline is available as a cloud hosted service that’s always up-to-date or as a self-hosted install on your own network. Notion is available only in the cloud.

faq.question: Is Notion better than Outline?
faq.answer: It depends on what your team needs. Notion is a flexible all-in-one workspace with databases, project tracking, and custom AI agents. Outline is a focused knowledge base for documents, with a fast user-friendly editor, and it can run on your own infrastructure. If you need databases or many custom workflows, Notion is a strong fit.

faq.question: Can I move my content from Notion?
faq.answer: Yes. Outline’s Notion import brings across pages, images, and attachments while keeping your structure.

faq.question: Can I self-host Outline instead?
faq.answer: Yes. Outline can be installed on your own network. Notion is only available as a cloud service.

closing: Ready to move from Notion? Get started in minutes…
